Which company has the highest total sale value over the three years. What is the difference between the value of the highest combined sales and the lowest combined sales registered by any company from 1999 to 2001.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total sales for each company:

ACG = 32 + 43 + 35 = 110

TYD = 61 + 52 + 29 = 142

POD = 54 + 25 + 36 = 115

BKN = 19 + 38 + 52 = 109

Highest total sales = 142 (TYD)

Lowest total sales = 109 (BKN)

Difference = 142 - 109 = 33

The company with the highest total sales is TYD with 142 lakhs.

The difference between the highest and lowest combined sales is 33 lakhs.
